PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Professional Services Agreement ("Agreement") is made effective as
of March 1, 2026, between Ridgeline Consulting LLC ("Consultant") and
Harbor Manufacturing Co. ("Client").

1. SCOPE OF SERVICES

Consultant shall perform an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system
implementation for Client, structured in three (3) sequential phases as
described below. Each phase constitutes a distinct deliverable accepted
independently by Client.

1.1 Phase 1 - Discovery and Requirements. Consultant shall conduct a
comprehensive assessment of Client's current systems and document
functional requirements in a Requirements Specification Document. Phase 1
is complete upon Client's written acceptance of the Requirements
Specification Document, expected within forty-five (45) days of the
Effective Date.

1.2 Phase 2 - System Configuration and Data Migration. Consultant shall
configure the ERP system per the accepted Requirements Specification
Document and migrate Client's historical data. Phase 2 is complete upon
successful completion of user acceptance testing (UAT), expected within
one hundred twenty (120) days of the Effective Date.

1.3 Phase 3 - Go-Live and Stabilization. Consultant shall support Client
through production go-live and provide thirty (30) days of post-go-live
stabilization support. Phase 3 is complete upon the conclusion of the
30-day stabilization period following go-live.

2. FEES AND MILESTONE BILLING

2.1 Phase 1 Fee. Client shall pay Consultant a fixed fee of $85,000 for
Phase 1, invoiced and due upon Client's written acceptance of the
Requirements Specification Document.

2.2 Phase 2 Fee. Client shall pay Consultant a fixed fee of $310,000 for
Phase 2, invoiced and due upon successful completion of user acceptance
testing.

2.3 Phase 3 Fee. Client shall pay Consultant a fixed fee of $105,000 for
Phase 3, invoiced and due upon conclusion of the 30-day stabilization
period.

2.4 Total Contract Value. The total value of this Agreement across all
three phases is $500,000.

3. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

3.1 Each phase requires Client's written acceptance before the applicable
milestone fee becomes due. Client shall have ten (10) business days to
review deliverables and either accept or provide written objections.

3.2 The parties agree that each phase represents a distinct performance
obligation, as each phase is separately identifiable and Client can
benefit from each phase's deliverables independently of the others, given
that the Requirements Specification Document (Phase 1) and the
implemented system (Phase 2) each have standalone value to Client's
operations.

4. TERM

4.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues until
all three phases are complete, currently estimated at approximately two
hundred (200) days from the Effective Date.

5. GENERAL PROVISIONS

5.1 Independent Contractor. Consultant is an independent contractor, not
an employee or agent of Client.

5.2 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of
Illinois.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement.
